glossary.бдитъ: бдѣти — keeps watch, is awake (3sg present)
glossary.березѣ: берегъ — bank (loc. sg., 'on the dark bank')
glossary.босымъ: босый — barefoot, unshod (instr. sg., 'as a barefoot [wolf]')
glossary.величія: величие — glory, greatness (gen. sg., after litotes 'не мало ... величія')
glossary.веселыми: веселый — joyful, merry (instr. pl., modifying пѣсьми)
glossary.вечеру: вечеръ — evening (dat. sg., used adverbially, 'in the evening')
glossary.влуръ: Влуръ — Vlur (nom. sg.); spelling variant of Овлуръ, the same Polovtsian helper
glossary.влъкомъ: вълкъ — wolf (instr. sg., 'as a wolf'; spelled влъкъ here)
glossary.втроскоташа: въстроскотати — chattered (aorist 3pl; prefixed variant of троскотати)
glossary.въвръжеся: въврещися — threw himself, flung himself (aorist 3sg reflexive)
glossary.гзакъ: Гзакъ — Gzak (nom. sg.); Polovtsian khan of the 1185 campaign
glossary.гоголемъ: гоголь — goldeneye, a diving duck (instr. sg., 'as a goldeneye')
glossary.горнастаемъ: горнастай — ermine, stoat (instr. sg., 'as an ermine')
glossary.дивицею: дѣвица — maiden (instr. sg.; spelled дивицею here, дѣвицею/дѣвице with ѣ two units on)
glossary.днѣпрь: Днѣпрь — the Dnepr (nom. sg.); the river
glossary.до: до — up to, as far as (prep. + gen.)
glossary.донецъ: Донецъ — the (river) Donets (nom. sg.); personified here as speaker
glossary.дону: Донъ — the Don (gen./dat. sg.); the river
glossary.дѣвице: дѣвица — maiden (gen. sg., short form, genitive of negation)
glossary.дѣвицею: дѣвица — maiden (instr. sg.; spelled with ѣ here, дивицею one unit before)
glossary.е: и (jь) — him (acc. sg.; old enclitic 3rd-person pronoun, ancestor of его in this role)
glossary.жалобою: жалоба — with lament, with grief (instr. sg.)
glossary.за: за — for, for the sake of; behind, beyond (prep.)
glossary.зелену: зеленый — green (dat./loc. sg. neut., modifying древу)
glossary.зелѣну: зелѣный — green (acc. sg. fem., modifying траву)
glossary.земли: земля — land, earth (gen. sg., 'out of the land'; also dat. sg., 'to the land, to the earth')
glossary.игорю: Игорь — Igor (dat. sg.; also vocative form, used in address 'Prince Igor!')
glossary.имѣя: имѣти — having (present participle, 'having a poor stream')
glossary.кликну: кликнути — gave a shout, cried out (aorist 3sg)
glossary.князи: кънязь — prince (loc. sg., in apposition to уноши)
glossary.князю: кънязь — to/upon the prince; for the prince (dat. sg.)
glossary.ко: къ — to, toward (prep. + dat.; spelled ко before Гзѣ)
glossary.комонь: комонь — steed, horse (nom./acc. sg.; poetic for конь)
glossary.комоня: комонь — steeds, horses (acc. dual, 'the two horses')
glossary.кончакови: Кончакъ — to Konchak (dat. sg.); Polovtsian khan, Igor's former captor
glossary.кончакомъ: Кончакъ — with Konchak (instr. sg.); Polovtsian khan, Igor's former captor
glossary.кончаку: Кончакъ — to/for Konchak (dat. sg.); Polovtsian khan, Igor's former captor
glossary.кончакъ: Кончакъ — Konchak (nom. sg.); Polovtsian khan, Igor's former captor
glossary.красною: красный — fair, beautiful (instr. sg. fem., modifying дивицею/дѣвицею)
glossary.красны: красный — fair, beautiful (gen. sg. fem., short form, genitive of negation)
glossary.кусту: кустъ — bush, thicket (loc. sg., 'upon the bush/thicket'; a debated sense, see note)
glossary.лелѣявшу: лелѣяти — who cradled (dat. sg. active past participle, agreeing with «ти»)
glossary.ли: ли — interrogative particle (here rhetorical, 'was it not ... ?')
glossary.млъвитъ: млъвити — speaks, murmurs (3sg present; cf. modern молвить)
glossary.мьглами: мъгла — mist, fog (instr. pl.; spelled мьгла here)
glossary.наю: мы — us two (acc. dual, 'the two of us')
glossary.обѣду: обѣдъ — dinner, midday meal (dat. sg., 'for dinner')
glossary.овлуръ: Овлуръ — Ovlur (nom. sg.); the Polovtsian who helps Igor escape (spelled Овлуръ here, Влуръ later in this part)
glossary.одѣвавшу: одѣвати — who clothed, dressed (dat. sg. active past participle, agreeing with «ти»)
glossary.опутаевѣ: опутати — let us [two] entangle, ensnare (1st dual non-past)
glossary.отню: отень — father's (possessive adj., dat. sg., modifying столу)
glossary.по: по — for, over (prep. + loc.; here after a verb of mourning, 'weeps for')
glossary.повѣдаютъ: повѣдати — announce, proclaim, tell (3rd pl. present)
glossary.подвизашася: подвизатися — stirred, were set in motion, were roused (aorist 3pl reflexive)
glossary.пожръши: пожрѣти — having swallowed up (past active participle fem., agreeing with рѣка)
glossary.половецкой: половецкый — Polovtsian, Cuman (gen. sg. fem., adj.)
glossary.половецкомъ: половецкый — Polovtsian, Cuman (loc. sg. neut., adj., modifying полѣ)
glossary.полозію: полозие — grass-snakes (nom. pl. collective; a large, harmless steppe snake)
glossary.полуночи: полуночь — midnight (loc. sg.; spelling variant of полунощь)
glossary.поля: поле — field, plain (gen. sg.; also acc. pl. 'fields, steppes')
glossary.помлъкоша: помлъкнути — fell silent, held their tongues (aorist 3pl)
glossary.претръгоста: претръгнути — strained, wore out, snapped (dual aorist 3rd)
glossary.прысну: прыснути — gave a gasp, burst forth (aorist 3sg)
glossary.прѣклонило: прѣклонити — bent down, bowed (aorist 3sg neut., 'it bent [itself]')
glossary.ростиславу: Ростиславъ — to/for Rostislav (dat. sg.); prince of Pereyaslavl who drowned in 1093
glossary.ростиславя: Ростиславъ — Rostislav's (possessive adj., nom. sg. fem., modifying мати, 'Rostislav's mother')
glossary.ростиславѣ: Ростиславъ — Rostislav (loc. sg., in apposition to Князи)
glossary.рострѣляевѣ: рострѣляти — let us [two] shoot (1st dual non-past)
glossary.руской: руский — Russian, of Rus' (dat. sg. fem., adj.)
glossary.рускую: руский — Russian, of Rus' (acc. sg. fem., adj.)
glossary.своими: свой — [with] our own (instr. pl., modifying стрѣлами)
glossary.своихъ: свой — his own (loc. pl., modifying брезѣхъ)
glossary.слѣду: слѣдъ — track, trail (loc. sg., 'on the track')
glossary.сморци: сморкъ — waterspouts, whirls/columns of mist (nom. pl.; a rare, uncertain word)
glossary.соколича: соколичь — falcon-chick (acc. sg.; Igor's young son, Vladimir Igorevich)
glossary.соколца: соколичь — falcon-chick (acc. sg.; variant spelling of соколича)
glossary.сокольца: соколичь — falcon-chick (gen. sg., genitive of negation, 'there will be no falcon-chick'; variant spelling with ь)
glossary.сребреныхъ: сребреный — silver, silvery (loc. pl., modifying брезѣхъ)
glossary.стлавшу: стьлати — who spread (dat. sg. active past participle, agreeing with «ти»)
glossary.стругы: стругы — currents, rills, channels (acc. pl.; a debated word)
glossary.стугою: стуга — with grief, with anguish (instr. sg.; echoes the river-name Стугна, see note)
glossary.студеную: студеный — cold (acc. sg. fem., modifying росу)
glossary.съ: съ — with (prep. + instr.); also off, down from (prep. + gen.)
glossary.ся: ся — reflexive particle ('-self'); here with подвизашася, 'were set in motion'
glossary.тектомъ: текотъ — tapping, a tapping sound (instr. sg.)
glossary.темнѣ: темный — dark (loc./dat. sg. fem., modifying березѣ)
glossary.ти: ты — for you, to you (dat. sg., enclitic)
glossary.тростію: тростие — reeds, reed-bed (dat. sg., after къ, 'to the reeds')
glossary.труся: трясти — shaking off, casting off (present participle, 'shaking from himself')
glossary.уноши: уноша — the youth (loc. sg., 'for the young [prince]')
glossary.худу: худый — poor, meager, thin (acc. sg. fem., modifying струю)
glossary.чужи: чужий — others', strange (acc. pl., modifying ручьи)
